message: 風呂と運動

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Demon Lord, what're ya thinkin' wandering around a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just enjoying a stroll under the crisp blue sky, letting the autumn breeze guide me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...I've got it all figured out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan told ya to take the day off, and since ya got no cash to burn, you're just aimlessly roaming the residential district, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「...*sniffle*」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're gonna start bawling, just stay put in your room!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Synn
message: 「Spending the whole day hugging my knees in the corner of a dark room with all the shutters closed, chuckling to myself over old memories--isn't that just too cruel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-I didn't even go that far, yet you take it to the next level, Synn-sama.」
Huh? Even though it's just the two of us, Paqy called me 'Synn' instead of 'Demon Lord'?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Attention, elite maidens of the fiery, high-spirited Sweets Club--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yumil... While I've been away on Student Council duty, has Sacchin always been giving commands like this?」

name: Yumil
message: 「Nah. Looks like Sacchin-senpai is just extra fired up today as vice president.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ Today I memorized lots of cool kanji just for you, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that so! Sorry about that... putting you through all that trouble. Though I feel like the direction of your effort is completely off the rails.」
We bump right into Nanaka and the others. Paqy must have sensed them coming early and changed how he addressed me.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, everyone. With this lineup, is this a Sweets Club gathering?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, 'sup!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Sakura-senpai, hey there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a coincidence, Synn! Since you're here, why don't you come with us?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh? No way~ Nana-chan's got a total bombshell figure, so she can't go into the men's bath~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I wouldn't do that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I'm completely lost here?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem! Today's meeting topic is--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Whether or not bathhouse fruit milk counts as a dessert!'」

name: Yumil
message: 「We're also gonna test strawberry milk and coffee milk. Right after our bath, of course.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Just so you know, Sacchin's the one who picked this theme, not me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so everyone's heading to the bathhouse now, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep! When I bought a bundle of voucher tickets, they threw in an extra one. So c'mon, you should come too, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'd love to come along. That bathhouse rents out towels, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, here's some Milky milk as thanks.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't want plain milk! Fruit milk is totally fine, though!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, I see--so Synn-kun is a last-minute addition--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Local ordinances say mixed bathing is only allowed up to age ten, but since Synn-kun looks so girlish, I bet he could accidentally slip into the women's bath--」

name: Synn
message: 「Deny it! I've grown at least a little bit, you know!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aren't you just putting on a tough front, Synn-kun? Getting all sudsy with Nana-chan is super fun, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I already took baths with Nanaka when we were kids, so I'm good.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What!? Sweet physical contact in the bath between Nana-chan and Synn-kun!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go imagining weird stuff, that was ages ago!」

name: Synn
message: 「It definitely was sweet, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-S-S-S-Synn!? Y-You've been thinking of me like that ever since we were kids......?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, the watermelon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Remember how we chilled a watermelon in your bathtub during summer break?」

name: Synn
message: 「Except your dad didn't notice and heated up the bathwater......」

name: Synn
message: 「When the bath finished heating up, there was a boiled watermelon floating around in the tub.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah, that did happen.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha. We screamed our heads off when we saw that steaming, pitch-black watermelon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then your mom stopped by to visit right at that moment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, right. Mom was thrilled since it's such a rare thing, and she cut the watermelon up for us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The inside was still nice and red. It was actually even sweeter and super delicious.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~ So ever since that incident, you've been obsessed with sweets, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Have not!」

name: Yumil
message: 「That story felt weirdly realistic, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, boiling the watermelon actually did happen, so.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~ Bath time soon~ Nana-chan, let's wash each other's bellies~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sure, though isn't it normally the back?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama. Let's wash each other's backs once in a while too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, some naked bonding isn't bad every now and then.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why did Misa suddenly pop up!?」

name: Misa
message: 「To think Paqy-san and Sakura-kun were in a naked relationship...!」

name: Synn
message: 「No! That's a huge misunderstanding!! Everybody, back me up!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Leave it to me~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Vice President. In American football, 'touchdown' means 'touching someone down to the ground,' right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you saying, Sacchin?」

name: Misa
message: 「Touching... H-How indecent!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh~? Did I mess up~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You actually thought that was gonna work?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Misa! Please, just listen to me!」
And so, on our day off right before KiraFes, I ended up having to sprint at full speed before even getting to take a bath....
